universal_lens: A Bayesian epistemic framework unifying player acceptance of VR training via cognitive load and perceived utility metrics. Relativist interpretivist ontology maps subjective VR training perceptions to multi-layered cognitive frameworks via qualitative thematic analysis.
gsi_mapping: GSI infers player acceptance priors from qualitative VR survey data using conformal predictive distributions over behavioral intent. Bayesian belief updating over player attitudinal states conditioned on VR utility and ease-of-use perceptions from interpretivist data.
gse_mapping: GSE models tactical decision-making transitions in VR vs. physical training using stochastic state-space representations with sensory feedback loops. Situationally grounded state transitions in VR training adoption driven by player motivational vectors and perceived performance gains.
